subject: Post-demo: security onboarding, notification timelines & contacts

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Subject: Post-demo: security onboarding, notification timelines & contacts

Hi Elaine,

Thanks again for taking the demo today — appreciate the sharp questions from your security and legal team. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get your procurement and security teams comfortable: 

1) Requested artifacts we can share right away: SOC 2 Type II summary, incident response playbook excerpt, and a short BCP/RTO-RPO summary (see attachments we will push shortly).

2) Questions from your side we picked up: whether Redwood treats Rivermark as a HIPAA-covered integration (we noted you mentioned PHI in certain workflows) and GDPR data routing preferences (EU region availability).

3) Breach notification / IR expectations: can you confirm your internal SLA for initial vendor notification? We typically provide initial notification within 72 hours for incidents impacting customer data, with a follow-up timeline for a full post-incident summary. Happy to align to your legal timeline where required.

4) Next steps: 
  - I will share the artifacts and a vendor security questionnaire template by EOD.
  - Monica (cc'd) will answer technical questions and can join a short onboarding call to walk the playbook.
  - Could you point me to the right security contact and legal reviewer (name + email) so we can coordinate evidence drop and any NDA/docu-sign steps?

If helpful, propose a 30-min security onboarding call during the week of Nov 16 — What works for your team?

Thanks,

Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri yom.das@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Elaine Dobson <elaine.dobson@rivermark.com>

Date: 2026-11-12T14:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: security onboarding, notification timelines & contacts

Hi Priyom — thanks for the recap.

Quick answers up front: Rivermark will need SOC 2 Type II evidence (attestation or AICPA report preferred), and HIPAA is applicable to the workflows we were demoing. GDPR applies for our EU tenants so we will want to confirm data residency and subprocessors.

For breach notification, our legal team requires initial vendor notification within 48 hours of detection for incidents that could expose PHI; we escalate based on impact. Can you confirm Redwood's typical detection-to-notification cadence and whether you have a 24/72 hour commitment in place?

Also, please send the vendor security questionnaire and the SOC 2 summary. Our security inbox (security-team@rivermark.com) will take the initial drop; cc'ing them here.

I can be the point of contact: Elaine Dobson (elaine.dobson@rivermark.com). I will loop in our privacy counsel separately if they need to review the SOC report.

Best,
Elaine
Senior IT Risk Manager | Rivermark Health
elaine.dobson@rivermark.com | +1 (646) 555-0199
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Elaine Dobson <elaine.dobson@rivermark.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: security onboarding, notification timelines & contacts

Elaine / Priyom — Monica here from Security Ops. Quick technical notes to address Elaine's questions: 

- SOC 2: Redwood holds a SOC 2 Type II report covering Security and Availability for our hosted inference product. We cannot publish the full report without an NDA, but I have attached the SOC 2 summary and the auditor's cover letter which cover control scope and testing period.

- HIPAA / PHI: We support HIPAA-eligible deployments; for hosted customers we offer BAA execution and can surface our data flow diagrams and encryption-in-transit/at-rest controls as part of the onboarding packet.

- GDPR / Data Residency: We have EU region deployments and subprocessors documented in the Data Processing Addendum. Please indicate if you require EU-only processing for specific tenants.

- Incident response & notification: Our standard internal SLA for initial vendor-relevant notification is to acknowledge detection and provide a preliminary notification within 48 hours for incidents with confirmed customer impact. We then follow up with a substantive post-incident report (timeline, root cause, remediation) within 14 business days, with an interim update cadence for high-severity events.

Attachments included in this thread: Redwood_SOC2_II_summary_2026.pdf; IR_Breach_Notification_Playbook_v1.pdf; BCP_RTO_RPO_Summary_2026.xlsx; Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Redwood.docx

If Rivermark requires a 24-hour initial notification window, please flag and we can assess contractual commitments via Legal.

I can host the onboarding call and walk through the IR playbook and containment flows. Priyom — want to propose slots and I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Security Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
